segments.narration: Google reviews dominate; focus your energy where the real customers are. Google reviews matter more for most small businesses.
consumers turn to Google when evaluating a local business through reviews (Source: BrightLocal Local Consumer Review Survey 2026).

Here's a number that surprises most business owners: 63 percent of consumers wrote a Google review in the past year, compared to just 24 percent who wrote one on Yelp (Source: BrightLocal Local Consumer Review Survey 2026).
Google accounts for roughly 73 percent of all online reviews globally (Source: SocialPilot Online Review Statistics 2025-2026).
Yelp had 22 million new reviews added in 2025, bringing its cumulative total into the hundreds of millions (Source: Yelp Trust & Safety Report 2025).
65 percent of consumers say they don't consider a star rating without any written text to be a "real" review (Source: Yelp Consumer Trust Survey, YouGov, January 2025).
